summary: Planned the REAFFIRM ruling as a two-phase documentary change. Phase 1 re-derives the frequency and wall-clock figures, then appends a dated amendment note after ground (d) of the 'Pre-Postflight-Sweep Deploy Trigger: Evaluated, Intentionally Not Built' subsection in the source store, leaving all four grounds byte-for-byte intact. Phase 2 redeploys via deploy-headless.sh and discharges the complete verify-deploy.sh gate set. No mechanism change: the completion-deploy gate and the Inter-Cycle Redeploy Checkpoint are explicit non-goals, and the trigger itself is not built.

artifacts.summary: Two-phase plan: re-confirm figures and append the dated REAFFIRM amendment, then redeploy and run the full gate set.
